name: Titanic-Survival-Prediction
description: This repository is an end-to-end machine learning project that predicts passenger survival on the Titanic using the classic Kaggle dataset. It benchmarks six different classification algorithms, handling everything from feature engineering and preprocessing to hyperparameter tuning.

name: InventoryManagement
description: A secure, full-stack Inventory Management System built to track products and orders in real time using a decoupled Java Spring Boot API and a modern React frontend. It leverages a cloud-native PostgreSQL database on Supabase and features robust JWT-based authentication with role-based access control. The entire architecture is fully deployed.

name: My-Portfolio

name: DogNose
description: DogNose uses machine learning to identify dogs by their unique nose prints—like a fingerprint for canines. Just snap a photo to register or recognize a dog instantly and non-invasively. It's built with a FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, and Supabase for data and vector storage. Simple, fast, and pet-friendly.

name: UptimeGuard
description: UptimeGuard is a free, serverless uptime monitor built with Next.js and Supabase—it pings your URLs, tracks response times, and alerts you via Discord when something goes down, all with minimal cost using a cron-based architecture.

name: pr-pilot
description: PR Pilot is a GitHub App that automatically reviews every pull request using Gemini 2.0 Flash—it fetches the diff, analyzes each file, and posts inline comments on exact lines like a senior engineer would, all in under 30 seconds.

name: SecretShield
description: SecretShield is an automated GitHub Action that scans every push and pull request to detect secrets (API keys, tokens, credentials) and sensitive files before they can be committed to your repository.

name: CodeMentor
description: CodeMentor is an AI coding assistant that teaches via Socratic questioning—asking guiding questions, not giving answers. It provides line-by-line explanations, structured code reviews with severity tags, and a learning progress graph, all powered by Next.js 15 and the Gemini API.
